cutoutPopIn.use: Photo cutouts (Capitol, hourglass, jet, money stacks) with a soft drop shadow.
cutoutPopIn.look: greyscale or lightly desaturated photo cutout, 3-4 px white rim optional, shadow 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.28)
cutoutPopIn.entry: frame 1 ghost (opacity 0.35); frame 2 solid at rotation -8° scale 0.9; settles to final rotation with 5% overshoot over 4-5 frames
cutoutPopIn.idle: hourglass has subtle continuous animation (sand); everything else is static

sticker.use: Torn red paper callout with the payoff number.
sticker.look: red #D2251D torn paper, white tiny typewriter top line, white Anton main line; final tilt -2..-3°

paperTag.use: Yellow or white paper label behind a word/number (BIGGEST BILL, PAST, corner counter).
paperTag.look: flat paper colour, 2 px ink outline for yellow tags, rotated -4..-6°
paperTag.pop: starts ~1.3x, settles to 1.0 in 2-3 shown frames

handStroke.use: Red marker arrow, circle and strike-through.
handStroke.look: red #D2251D, 5-6 px, round caps, slight wobble (hand-drawn path, not geometric)
handStroke.draw: stroke-dashoffset reveal over 5-8 frames, ease-out; circle starts at top and goes clockwise and overshoots ~10°; strike extends ~30 px past the text

progressBar.geometry: capsule outline 3 px ink, height ~34 px, x 320-1610, y≈730; labels NOW / END tiny typewriter below at y≈775
progressBar.drawOn: right end extends from x≈1372 to ≈1610 over f0-12, ease-out; flag on a pole fades in f7-12 at the right end
progressBar.fill: red fill grows linearly with elapsed/total frames from f16; white knob with ink outline at the fill end

moneyStackRow.look: green banknote bundles (greens #385127..#8AB582) with a paper band, soft shadow
moneyStackRow.layout: 7 per row, pitch 211 px, x 220-1700; row 1 baseline y≈910, row 2 sits on top
moneyStackRow.entry: left -> right, one every 1.5-2 frames, ghost frame then solid, last items drop ~20 px
moneyStackRow.exit: whole group scales toward (960, 690) with ease-in over 6 frames (0.97, 0.9, 0.75, 0.45, 0.2, 0)

personGrid.look: head-and-shoulders pictogram, ink #191410 (others grey #756F6A when one is singled out), one red person
personGrid.entry: icons start as dots and scale up in a radial wave from the centre over ~8 frames
personGrid.billBurst: cluster of bills at the centre bursts outward and each settles above a person's head over ~10 frames
personGrid.focus: grid splits (halves slide out), push-in 1x -> 3x on the red person over 6 frames, others grey and bills desaturate; reverse when pulling back
